officialText:
Enactment date: 5/19/2014

Int. No. 93-A

By Council Members Matteo, Ignizio, Gentile, Rose, Richards, Rosenthal, Arroyo, Constantinides, Lander and Ulrich (by request of the Staten Island Borough President)

A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York and the New York city building code, in relation to requiring the use of mold-resistant gypsum board and cement board in moisture-prone locations.

Be it enacted by the Council as follows:

* * *

[Consolidated provisions are not included in this Appendix A]

* * *

§ 6. This local law shall take effect on October 1, 2014, except that this local law shall not apply to construction work related to applications for construction document approval filed prior to such effective date, and except that the commissioner of buildings shall take such measures as are necessary for its implementation, including the promulgation of rules, prior to such effective date.
